description: List the creator pay other organizations owe or paid the caller's organization for its signed hires, newest first and at most 200, as the web app's payouts page shows it: earnedCents, the total paid so far, and each transfer's id, campaignName, hiredByName, amountCents, createdAt, paidAt (null while it is not paid), and shortfallReason when a paid transfer fell short. Needs a credential.
name: list_payouts
title: List payouts
